messages:
marta: Quick sync — EdgeMorph + Integr8 marketplace launch needs a razor‑sharp ops checklist. Who's owning press embargo, blog draft, landing hero, and SI integration runbook?

alex: I can own the landing hero + CDN cutover checklist. planning to lock hero copy by EOD Thu. Need final hero image from creative.

sam: I'll take blog draft and customer quote coordination. Can we get one early adopter quote from Integr8 by Monday? @jess can you chase? :pray:

jess: Yep, pinged Integr8 PM this morning. They said they'd try for a single-line quote by Mon PST. I'll escalate if no reply.

leah: I'm on press embargo windows and legal signoff. We need embargo text + embargo list by Friday to route to counsel. Also need press release contact details.

marta: Thanks. High level timeline idea:
- Tue: final hero & blog draft
- Wed: legal embargo signoff
- Thu: partner quote in blog + landing localized strings
- Fri: staging cutover + dry run
Can we align owners to these bullets?

alex: timeline works. I'll schedule a 30m dry run with CDN and analytics post-deploy. deploy-bot, can you reserve the staging window?

deploy-bot: Staging window reserved: 2025-06-12T16:00:00Z - 2025-06-12T17:00:00Z. Added to #release-war-room.

sam: For tracking: we need UTM params and tag mapping for partner-sourced leads. Nate, can you add Integr8 UTM and edgemorph_campaign keys to the tracking doc?

nate: On it. Will add UTM list + sample GA4 events by EOD today.

leah: Legal asks: include embargo recipients list + embargo date/time in this format: 
```
EMBARGO: 2025-06-13T00:00:00Z
RECIPIENTS: list@press, partner-press@edgemorph.com
```
Also confirm whether Integr8 wants an embargoed briefing.

marta: Integr8 requested a briefing for partner SIs on Wed morning. Jess — can you coordinate an invite with Integr8 PM + 5 SI leads?

jess: Will set up Wed 10:00am PT and share calendar invite + brief doc.

tom: SI integration checklist (my team):
- preflight: sample tenant provisioned
- smoke: SSO + webhook flows tested
- perf: 1000 req/min smoke run
- rollback: integration toggle ready
I'll post the runbook link in the thread when done.

marta: Great. Two open risk items: localized landing copy for FR/DE and hero image license clearance from creative. If either slips we need press fallback (quote-only release). Any volunteers to own localization?

alex: I can own FR/DE localization coordination with l10n ops. Will need strings by Wed AM.

leah: On hero image licensing — creative flagged a stock element that might need extended license. Creative asked legal to expedite. legal-bot, any ETA?

legal-bot: Legal review queued. Expected turnaround 48 hours from request timestamp. If expedited, add label `priority-embargo` to ticket.

marta: Ok — action items summary:
- alex: finalize hero + CDN dry run (by Thu)
- sam: blog draft + integrate quote (by Thu)
- jess: chase partner quote & schedule SI briefing (by Mon/Wed)
- tom: SI runbook + smoke tests (by Thu)
- nate: UTM + GA4 mapping (by EOD)
- leah: embargo list + legal signoff (by Wed)
- deploy-bot: staging window reserved (confirmed)

sam: One more ask — can we include a short technical FAQ for SI onboarding on the landing? Helps reduce pre-signal support traffic. I'll draft 5 Qs.

marta: Love it. Keep the FAQ tight. Final note: if licensing delays hero, fallback plan is publish blog + partner quote on schedule and do landing incremental update next week. Everyone ok with that?

participants: thumbs? :thumbsup: 

alex: :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

leah: :thumbsup:

nate: :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks all — I'll convert action items to GH issues and assign owners. Will update in 2 hours.
